title: DeepShield — Adversarial Image Protection Prototype
oneLine: An adversarial image-protection engine and paired evaluation harness built to expose where transfer works, where it fails, and what it costs visually.
role: Ali authored the initial enhanced pipeline and later robustness methods; BlurGuard authors and former collaborators are credited in the repository.

evidence.sample: 6 deterministic software tests; no model-effectiveness experiment
evidence.scope: schema, JPEG preprocessing, matrix rendering, and fake-adapter paired-run persistence
